set.body: Source: https://github.com/canardlapin/meridianfx/issues/4 (reported at cf5bbff69203556ee8b31ea566502d502e766386). Independently reproduce computed native selection contrast before repair. Preserve rounded inset selection and distinct view focus. Cover ListView and TreeView, light/dark, compact/comfortable, focused/unfocused and selected hover. Require an essential >=3:1 cue against both cell background and selected fill, explicit generated contrast recipes, and a regression that fails on the original resources and passes after repair. Keep synthetic fixtures, source hashes, command exits and native observations. Related to C2; no B0/B1 prerequisite. This bounded repair does not close C2 or qualify the docked workspace.
set.title: [Bug #4] Restore a measurable ListView/TreeView selection cue
